items.summary: Recommendation: retain containment and approve no new finance-driven spend or monetization forecast. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. All $4.92 is in an aggregate provider row and cannot be assigned to a site; named site rows show $0 attributed commission. Do not convert clicks, orders, shipped items, SEO conversions, or AI output into revenue, ROI, contribution margin, or causal lift. AI usage for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 is $1,002.45979265 across 5,531 calls, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors; this is not comparable to the one-day revenue window and is not a margin calculation. Keep the existing capacity gate and queued CTA refinement unchanged.

Contribution margin is not calculable because site-level revenue is unavailable for the aggregate $4.92, and infrastructure, domain, vendor, labor, and other operating costs are not supplied. Cost-to-learn is also not calculable because AI calls and dollars are not linked to a defined learning outcome, delivered artifact, experiment exposure, or measured incremental result. Minimum measurement: same-period site/content identifier, registered affiliate tracking ID, clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, AI cost, infrastructure/vendor cost, and a defined verified outcome. Until then, report gross provider totals and AI spend separately and label margin, ROI, CAC, payback, and forecast revenue unknown.
